name: nagi-ui-workspace
description: Workspace for Nagi UI, an own-first Vue component system with platform-first Blueprints.

scripts.lint: oxlint packages/core/src packages/eslint-plugin-nagi-ui/src tests/types --ignore-path .gitignore --type-check --tsconfig=tsconfig.json && oxlint packages/core/blueprints playground/src demos/NativePopoverDropdown.vue --ignore-path .gitignore && oxlint packages/core/cli packages/core/components.ts packages/core/nagi-css-preset.mjs packages/core/style-compiler.mjs packages/core/vite.package.config.ts packages/core/theme packages/core/recipes/testing tests/*.test.ts tests/browser scripts/audits/package-exports-audit.mjs scripts/evaluations playground/vite.config.ts playwright.config.ts eslint.nagi.config.mjs --ignore-path .gitignore
scripts.lint:fix: oxlint packages/core/src packages/eslint-plugin-nagi-ui/src tests/types --ignore-path .gitignore --type-check --tsconfig=tsconfig.json --fix && oxlint packages/core/blueprints playground/src demos/NativePopoverDropdown.vue --ignore-path .gitignore --fix && oxlint packages/core/cli packages/core/components.ts packages/core/nagi-css-preset.mjs packages/core/style-compiler.mjs packages/core/theme packages/core/recipes/testing tests/*.test.ts tests/browser playground/vite.config.ts playwright.config.ts eslint.nagi.config.mjs --ignore-path .gitignore --fix
scripts.lint:runtime: oxlint packages/core/cli packages/core/components.ts packages/core/nagi-css-preset.mjs packages/core/style-compiler.mjs packages/core/vite.package.config.ts packages/core/theme packages/core/recipes/testing tests/*.test.ts tests/browser scripts/audits/package-exports-audit.mjs scripts/evaluations playground/vite.config.ts playwright.config.ts eslint.nagi.config.mjs --ignore-path .gitignore
scripts.evaluate:naming: node scripts/evaluations/naming-derivation.mjs --check docs/evaluations/naming-derivation.json && node scripts/evaluations/semantic-erasure.mjs --check docs/evaluations/semantic-erasure.json
scripts.audit:templates: oxfmt --check packages/core/blueprints && node scripts/audits/template-responsibility-audit.mjs && node scripts/audits/behavior-binding-audit.mjs && node scripts/audits/behavior-source-review-audit.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.test-contracts.json && vue-tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.vue.json
